title: Superpower offer panel
description: A full-window welcome offer over warm photography: a small white tag pill, a big centred two-line white headline, a short question, and a stack of five tall white answer pills (the last one frosted and outlined), with a row of small facts near the foot. Centred on phones; on desktop it sits in the right half of the window. As an overlay it fades in on load and has a round frosted close button.
notes: forces the dark class on itself
overlay: covers the window (fixed) until closed; without it the panel is an ordinary window-tall section
not placed on the superpower landing page: the original shows it as a popup on arrival
